Since the ztest thread runs at cooperative priority `-1` while the TTY backend polling thread runs at priority `10` with a 100ms sleep between polls, `k_yield()` neither yielded to the lower-priority backend thread nor advanced simulated time on `native_sim`. Replacing `k_yield()` with `k_sleep(TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_OP_DELAY)` (matching the other tests in the suite) allows the backend polling thread to run and raise the `MODEM_PIPE_EVENT_RECEIVE_READY` event. All tests in `modem_backend_tty_suite` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
